title: Devon Witherspoon's blitzes threw off Drake Maye, Patriots

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Devon Witherspoon's blitzes threw off Drake Maye, Patriots
sources.description: Uchenna Nwosu's 45-yard return for a touchdown in the fourth quarter to seal the Seahawks' victory initially was ruled a strip-sack by cornerback Devon Witherspoon.
